<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Abdullah Ahzam Farhan - Freelance AI UGC Video Creator</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#eefaf8;--bg2:#dff3fb;--ink:#0b1b2b;--mute:#4a5d6e;--card:#ffffffcc;--line:#c9e3ea;color-scheme:light;--blue:#1573e6;--green:#12c48b;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);line-height:1.55}
.wrap{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
.top{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--bg2),var(--bg));padding-bottom:36px}
nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:18px 0}
.logo{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--green));color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.ic{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.ic svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:#fff;fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.in .ic{background:#0a66c2}.ig .ic{background:linear-gradient(45deg,#f9a825,#e1306c,#7b3fe4)}.tt .ic{background:#111}.wa .ic{background:#25d366}.ph .ic{background:var(--blue)}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,320px) 1fr;gap:36px;align-items:center;padding-top:14px}
.photo{aspect-ratio:1/1.05;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--blue),var(--green));display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:88px;font-weight:800;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 20%;display:block}
.photo small{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;opacity:.85}
h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5.4vw,52px);line-height:1.08;margin:0 0 22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h2{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 16px;font-weight:800}
.svc{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 22px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.svc li{display:flex;gap:10px;font-weight:500}
.svc li::before{content:"";flex:none;width:10px;height:10px;margin-top:8px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--green))}
.stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.stat{flex:1 1 120px;text-align:center;padding:14px 10px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
section{padding:40px 0 8px}
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:18px}
.vid{display:block;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.thumb{aspect-ratio:16/10;display:grid;place-items:center}
.t1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f6d9c8,#e7b9a3)}
.t2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0d1620,#3a4654)}
.t3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1d7e6,#cfe6f0)}
.play{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffffe6;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .2s}
.play::after{content:"";margin-left:5px;border-left:16px solid var(--blue);border-top:10px solid transparent;border-bottom:10px solid transparent}
.vid{margin:0}
.vid video{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:9/16;max-height:520px;object-fit:cover;background:#000}
.vid figcaption b{padding-top:14px}
.soon{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:300px;text-align:center;border-style:dashed;color:var(--mute)}
.soon .play{margin:0 auto 12px;background:var(--bg2)}
.soon b{padding:0}
.vid b{display:block;padding:14px 16px 2px}
.vid span{display:block;padding:0 16px 14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
.quote{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:24px;align-items:center}
blockquote{margin:0;font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,28px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.3}
.who{color:var(--mute);font-size:14px;margin-top:8px}
.links{display:grid;gap:10px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.btn.main{background:#0b1b2b;color:#fff}
.btn.alt{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);justify-content:flex-start}
.band{margin-top:44px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#0d63d8,#12c48b);color:#fff;padding:36px 0 28px}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:28px}
.band h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px}
.band ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:15px}
.band small{display:block;margin-top:22px;opacity:.9}
.off{opacity:.55}
@media (max-width:720px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.photo{max-width:300px}.quote{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true"><defs>
<symbol id="i-in" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 10v8M6 6.5v.01M11 18v-8M11 13.5c0-2.2 1.5-3.5 3.5-3.5s3.5 1.2 3.5 3.6V18"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-ig" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3.6"/><path d="M16.8 7.2v.01"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-tt" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M14 4v10.2a3.7 3.7 0 1 1-3.7-3.7M14 4c.3 2.3 1.9 3.9 4.2 4.1"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-wa" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3.5a8.5 8.5 0 0 0-7.3 12.8L3.5 20.5l4.3-1.1A8.5 8.5 0 1 0 12 3.5z"/><path d="M9.3 8.8c-.3.6-.2 1.6.8 3 1.1 1.5 2.3 2.2 3.3 2.3.7 0 1.2-.5 1.3-1l-1.4-.8-.6.6c-.8-.3-1.7-1.2-2-2l.6-.6-.7-1.5z"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-ph" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 4h4l2 5-2.5 1.5a11 11 0 0 0 5 5L15 13l5 2v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2A15 15 0 0 1 3 6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2z"/></symbol>
</defs></svg>
<header class="top">
 <div class="wrap">
  <nav>
   <div class="logo" aria-hidden="true">A</div>
   <div class="chips">
    <a class="chip in" data-link="linkedin" href="#"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-in"/></svg></span>LinkedIn</a>
    <a class="chip ig" data-link="instagram" href="#"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-ig"/></svg></span>Instagram</a>
    <a class="chip tt" data-link="tiktok" href="#"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-tt"/></svg></span>TikTok</a>
    <a class="chip wa" data-link="whatsapp" href="#"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-wa"/></svg></span>WhatsApp</a>
   </div>
  </nav>
  <div class="hero">
   <div class="photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Abdullah Ahzam Farhan"></div>
   <div>
    <h1>Abdullah Ahzam Farhan - Freelance AI UGC Video Creator.</h1>
    <h2>Services</h2>
    <ul class="svc">
     <li>AI-Powered Short Videos</li>
     <li>Engaging UGC Style Content</li>
     <li>Trend-Driven Shorts for TikTok / Reels</li>
     <li>Voiceover &amp; Editing</li>
    </ul>
    <div class="stats"><div class="stat">Analytics</div><div class="stat">Engagement Boost</div><div class="stat">Creative Strategy</div></div>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</header>

<main class="wrap">
 <section>
  <h2>Portfolio</h2>
  <div class="grid3">
   <figure class="vid"><video controls playsinline preload="metadata" poster="data:image/jpeg;base64," src="data:video/mp4;base64,"></video><figcaption><b>Luxury Fragrance Ad</b><span>Cinematic perfume advertisement</span></figcaption></figure>
   <figure class="vid"><video controls playsinline preload="metadata" poster="data:image/jpeg;base64," src="data:video/mp4;base64,"></video><figcaption><b>Perfume UGC Reel</b><span>Short-form reel for TikTok / Reels</span></figcaption></figure>

  </div>
 </section>

 <section>

   </div>
   <div class="links">
    <a class="btn alt ph" data-link="phone" href="#"><span class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-ph"/></svg></span>0303 9553489</a>

 </section>

 <div class="wrap">

   <div><h3>Experience</h3><ul><li>Freelance UGC Creator (1 year)</li><li>AI Tool Proficiency (various platforms)</li><li>Successful Brand Collaborations</li></ul></div>

var LINKS = {

  tiktok: "",
  instagram: "https://www.instagram.com/spark_digitalco?stkn=MWxzNjY2OW9mNGlrdQ==",

  email: ""

document.querySelectorAll("[data-link]").forEach(function(a){
